pages.title: Terrain Overview
pages.text: The current world contains 125 new terrain biomes. All terrain biomes in the 1.20 world use this mod's new terrain system rather than the old terrain set.

pages.title: Terrain Selection
pages.text: Selection combines temperature, rainfall, distance from the coast, volcanic stage, glacial state, and terrain height, covering oceans, shores, land, karst, volcanoes, glaciers, rivers, and lakes.

pages.title: Common Regions
pages.text: Common regions include Plains ($(thing)tfc:plains$()), Hills ($(thing)tfc:hills$()), Rolling Hills ($(thing)tfc:rolling_hills$()), Highlands ($(thing)tfc:highlands$()),

pages.title: Mountain Regions
pages.text: Mountains ($(thing)tfc:mountains$()), and Old Mountains ($(thing)tfc:old_mountains$()). The codes in parentheses can be used to locate the corresponding biomes.

pages.title: Oceans and Ridges
pages.text: Ocean and ridge biomes sit around continental margins and in deep water, including Ocean Atolls ($(thing)tfc:ocean_atolls$()), Deep Ocean Atolls ($(thing)tfc:deep_ocean_atolls$()), and Ocean Ridge ($(thing)tfc:ocean_ridge$()).$(br)

pages.title: Rivers and Rifts
pages.text: Rivers and rifts follow watersheds and continental breaks, including River Valley ($(thing)tfc:river_valley$()), Rift Valley ($(thing)tfc:rift_valley$()), and Rift Lake ($(thing)tfc:rift_lake$()).$(br)

pages.title: Volcanoes and Islands
pages.text: Volcanoes and islands appear around hotspots, volcanic arcs, and islands, including Oceanic Volcanic Arc ($(thing)tfc:oceanic_volcanic_arc$()), Volcanic Island ($(thing)tfc:volcanic_island$()),

pages.title: Volcanic Islands
pages.text: Volcanic Mountain Islands ($(thing)tfc:volcanic_mountain_islands$()), and Collisional Mountains ($(thing)tfc:collisional_mountains$()).$(br)

pages.title: Glacial Terrain
pages.text: Glacial volcanic combinations require cold high-latitude or high-elevation volcanic terrain; each family transitions through several temperature, rainfall, and height stages.

pages.title: Oceans
pages.text: The oceans include Ocean ($(thing)tfc:ocean$()), Ocean Reef ($(thing)tfc:ocean_reef$()), Deep Ocean ($(thing)tfc:deep_ocean$()), and Deep Ocean Trench ($(thing)tfc:deep_ocean_trench$()).

pages.title: Coasts
pages.text: Coasts can form Rocky Shores ($(thing)tfc:rocky_shores$()), Tidal Flats ($(thing)tfc:tidal_flats$()), Embayments ($(thing)tfc:embayments$()), Coastal Dunes ($(thing)tfc:coastal_dunes$()), and Sea Stacks ($(thing)tfc:sea_stacks$()).

pages.title: Seafloor Depth
pages.text: The seafloor deepens the farther it is from land; see $(l:new_terra_earth/deepening_oceans)Oceans That Deepen With Distance$() for the stages and depths. Ocean Ridge and atoll entries are listed on the previous page.

pages.title: Landforms (1)
pages.text: Landforms include Badlands ($(thing)tfc:badlands$()), Canyons ($(thing)tfc:canyons$()), Low Canyons ($(thing)tfc:low_canyons$()), Lowlands ($(thing)tfc:lowlands$()), Plateau ($(thing)tfc:plateau$()), Plateau Wide ($(thing)tfc:plateau_wide$()),

pages.title: Landforms (2)
pages.text: Mesas ($(thing)tfc:mesas$()), Buttes ($(thing)tfc:buttes$()), and Hoodoos ($(thing)tfc:hoodoos$()).

pages.title: Karst (1)
pages.text: Karst branches include Tower Karst Plains ($(thing)tfc:tower_karst_plains$()), Shilin Plains ($(thing)tfc:shilin_plains$()), Doline Plains ($(thing)tfc:doline_plains$()), Cenote Plains ($(thing)tfc:cenote_plains$()),

pages.title: Karst (2)
pages.text: Tower Karst Canyons ($(thing)tfc:tower_karst_canyons$()), Doline Canyons ($(thing)tfc:doline_canyons$()), Cenote Canyons ($(thing)tfc:cenote_canyons$()),

pages.title: Karst (3)
pages.text: Tower Karst Hills ($(thing)tfc:tower_karst_hills$()), Doline Hills ($(thing)tfc:doline_hills$()), and Cenote Hills ($(thing)tfc:cenote_hills$()).

pages.title: Volcanoes (1)
pages.text: Volcanic landforms include Active Shield Volcano ($(thing)tfc:active_shield_volcano$()), Dormant Shield Volcano ($(thing)tfc:dormant_shield_volcano$()), Extinct Shield Volcano ($(thing)tfc:extinct_shield_volcano$()), Ancient Shield Volcano ($(thing)tfc:ancient_shield_volcano$()), Sunken Shield Volcano ($(thing)tfc:sunken_shield_volcano$()),

pages.title: Volcanoes (2)
pages.text: Volcanic Mountains ($(thing)tfc:volcanic_mountains$()), and Volcanic Oceanic Mountains ($(thing)tfc:volcanic_oceanic_mountains$()).

pages.title: Glaciers and Ice Sheets
pages.text: Cold regions can generate Ice Sheet ($(thing)tfc:ice_sheet$()), Ice Sheet Mountains ($(thing)tfc:ice_sheet_mountains$()), Glaciated Mountains ($(thing)tfc:glaciated_mountains$()), and Glacially Carved Mountains ($(thing)tfc:glacially_carved_mountains$()).

pages.title: Glacial Transitions
pages.text: New volcanic arcs and islands are listed on the previous page.

pages.title: Rivers and Headwaters (1)
pages.text: River ($(thing)tfc:river$()) and headwater streams form connected water systems.

pages.title: Rivers and Headwaters (2)
pages.text: A headwater follows natural downhill terrain and can create bends, rapids, waterfalls, and spreading flow before gradually joining a main river; the new River Valley, Rift Valley, and Rift Lake entries are listed on the previous page.

pages.title: Exploration Tip
pages.text: Terrain appears only in newly generated chunks. Travel along coasts, rivers, and mountain ranges to find the different transitions; existing chunks are not reshaped automatically.
